resources.string: Shows a floating mic bubble when you are typing and inserts your dictated text into the focused text field. Vox reads the focused text field and the name of the current app. With Learn from my corrections on (the default; switch it off in Vox, Settings, Privacy), for up to 3 minutes after Vox types, or until you send it, Vox also reads the text of the fields that change in that app (usually the one it typed into; up to 20,000 characters) to notice the words you fix; only the changed words are kept, in your dictionary, which goes to your speech and cleanup servers as spelling hints and, with sync on, to your relay; password fields are never read. Audio is sent to the speech server you set in Vox, and the text of what you said, with the name of the app you are in, is sent to the cleanup server you set (both Groq by default), each with your own API key. If you turn on relay sync, voice notes and your profile also go to your own relay. If you turn on "Use my relay as the AI server", the audio and text go to your relay instead.
